title: Down in the Cellar  (Abajo en el sótano)

segments.t: Abajo en el sótano de ladrillo bajo el patio, Hannah le entrega a Graham la válvula nueva mientras alumbra con una linterna potente la caldera apagada. Escuchemos primero.
Here are both brass valves, Graham! Catch my breath? Never!
Hold this flashlight steady on the pipe joint right here.
Got it! Did you turn off the main water tap already?
Off and drained. Pass me the heavy wrench on your left.
This big iron one? Here you go.
One turn, two turns... look how clean that new brass thread fits.
No drips at all! Can we light the boiler now?
Open the blue wheel slowly to the left, not too fast.
Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!
And there goes the burner flame, steady blue, just how it should be.
Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!
Three minutes to reach the third floor. Good run today, partner.
Vamos a repasar la escena línea por línea.
Here are both brass valves, Graham! Catch my breath? Never!
'¡Aquí están las dos válvulas de latón, Graham! ¿Recuperar el aliento? ¡Jamás!'
Hold this flashlight steady on the pipe joint right here.
'Sujeta firme esta linterna sobre la junta de la tubería justo aquí.'
Got it! Did you turn off the main water tap already?
'¡Listo! ¿Ya cerraste la llave de paso principal del agua?'
Off and drained. Pass me the heavy wrench on your left.
'Cerrada y vaciada. Pásame la llave inglesa pesada que tienes a tu izquierda.'
This big iron one? Here you go.
'¿Esta grande de hierro? Aquí tienes.'
One turn, two turns... look how clean that new brass thread fits.
'Una vuelta, dos vueltas... mira qué limpia encaja esa rosca nueva de latón.'
No drips at all! Can we light the boiler now?
'¡Ni una gota! ¿Podemos encender la caldera ahora?'
Open the blue wheel slowly to the left, not too fast.
'Abre despacio la rueda azul hacia la izquierda, no demasiado rápido.'
Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!
'Girando despacio... ¡escucha! ¡El agua está entrando con fuerza!'
And there goes the burner flame, steady blue, just how it should be.
'Y ahí prende la llama del quemador, azul constante, justo como debe estar.'
Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!
'¡Toca el tubo de cobre! ¡Ya se está calentando!'
Three minutes to reach the third floor. Good run today, partner.
'Tres minutos para llegar al tercer piso. Buena carrera hoy, compañera.'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a velocidad normal.
Here are both brass valves, Graham! Catch my breath? Never!
Hold this flashlight steady on the pipe joint right here.
Got it! Did you turn off the main water tap already?
Off and drained. Pass me the heavy wrench on your left.
This big iron one? Here you go.
One turn, two turns... look how clean that new brass thread fits.
No drips at all! Can we light the boiler now?
Open the blue wheel slowly to the left, not too fast.
Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!
And there goes the burner flame, steady blue, just how it should be.
Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!
Three minutes to reach the third floor. Good run today, partner.
Una llama azul constante, tuberías de cobre calentándose y Graham llamando 'compañera' a Hannah en vez de 'novata'. En la próxima escena subimos al desayuno. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
